limitations: Reviews admit unmodified dependencies for the existing Apizr runtime/development/documentation/security and Homebrew build-only uses. Apizr wheel and sdist do not vendor these packages.
Evidence is one SHA-256-verified locked source archive per version, except pywin32 (one locked wheel). Other wheel hashes are bound to the review but their contents were not exhaustively inspected.

This is a Python package/license-notice inventory, not a file-level legal audit or a complete SBOM for native libraries, transitive Cargo/npm code, OS packages, nested wheels, or dynamically downloaded tooling.

Before distributing containers, vendored packages, modified third-party code or additional documentation assets, review the exact contents and fulfill source, notice, attribution, font and trademark obligations. This gate alone does not authorize those distributions.

An SPDX expression describes the identified component scope, not every byte of every upstream archive. Upstream test-fixture dummy licenses and unused documentation are retained as evidence, not silently treated as the package license.
